matches_brief: §3 Core experience / what counts as solving
solved_when: Player can support A–D from the open record set (not from sealed D018).

elements.name: Supportable widow
elements.player_must_establish: Which claimant’s marriage is the undissolved prior union that controls widow status

correct.name: Martha Jane (Ashby) Corbett
correct.basis: 1858 lawful marriage undissolved; Martha never remarried; prior spouse living through 1866–1887

incorrect_if: Chooses Lydia solely because D004/D013 name her
Chooses Lydia because ceremony + cohabitation feel more ‘real’ without addressing prior marriage

elements.name: Claimant beliefs
elements.player_must_establish: What each woman believed or asserted in her file (sincere vs knowingly false is a separate layer)

correct.Martha: Asserts 1858 marriage + soldier’s wartime death of disease; lives as widow on wartime word — marriage claim correct; death timing incorrect
correct.Lydia: Asserts 1866 marriage + 1887 death as his widow; believes first wife died of fever (as told by Elias) — sincere on open evidence

elements.not_required: Proving Lydia knew about Martha during the marriage (sealed may color; open default is lied-to)

elements.name: What happened
elements.player_must_establish: Soldier’s wartime fate from conflicting military paper + postwar life

correct.wartime: Did not die in 1863; desertion / left convalescence after conflicting dead vs deserted paper
correct.postwar: Lived with Lydia in Jefferson until death 1887-02-14 pneumonia

incorrect_if: Treats D007 alone as definitive death

elements.name: Why both claims look real
elements.player_must_establish: Which documents legitimately support each file without collapsing ‘record says X’ into ‘X happened’

correct.teaching: Both documentary stories are real witnesses; only one is supportable under undissolved prior marriage

explicitly_not_required: Modern legal advice / full pension-law treatise
Knowing Elias’s cruelty level beyond quiet new-life desertion
fail_incomplete_if: Picks widow solely because death certificate names her
Conflates ceremony happened with marriage was lawful
Treats a single muster/hospital line as definitive without addressing the conflicting roll + postwar life

sealed_after_submit.player_should_feel: Confirmation, not a new legal theory

grading_notes_for_proof.pass: A–D supported with exhibit IDs from open set; uncertainty preserved on sealed motives
grading_notes_for_proof.partial: Correct widow but no conflict reconstruction, or correct desertion story but Lydia chosen as supportable
